title: Gauss formalizes the Strong Prime Number Theorem in Lean
summary: Math Inc's autoformalization agent produced about 25,000 lines of Lean with over 1,000 theorems and definitions in roughly three weeks, on a project set by Terence Tao and Alex Kontorovich in 2024. Figures are company-reported; the project notes targeted human scaffolding and review of key lemmas. Announcement date unconfirmed: September 2025 is taken from the repository's single commit (11 September).

evidence.tested: Formalization in Lean, a machine-checked proof of the stated claim, with targeted human scaffolding and review of key lemmas.
evidence.ai_role: Gauss autoformalization agent produced most statements and proofs (about 25,000 lines of Lean) on the Strong Prime Number Theorem.
